summary: Iteration 6 end-to-end validation (backend + frontend) for Dashboard swap, Settings catalogs module, sidebar collapse/mobile drawer, and delete-lock for paid_personally expenses. 5/5 backend tests PASS. 14/14 frontend checks PASS. All test data was cleaned up.

issues: Carry-over from iter 5: date inputs are native HTML <input type='date'> (browser-default picker) instead of the shadcn calendar used elsewhere. Cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend /api/settings/catalogs (list, GET by key, PUT by key) work as designed. PUT accepts {items: [{value,label}]} and persists; GET reflects the updated list. Invalid keys return 400 (verified).

Backend delete_tx lock: an expense with paid_personally=true and no reimbursement covering its tx_id returns 409 with Spanish message 'No se puede eliminar... aún no se ha reembolsado. Registra primero el reembolso en el Portal de Socios.' After creating a /api/reimbursements with source_transaction_ids including the tx, delete succeeds (200/204). Verified end-to-end with cleanup.

Reimbursement linkage uses source_transaction_ids — without including tx_id in source_transaction_ids the expense remains locked even if the amount is covered. This is the intended design but worth documenting in API docs for any future integrators.
Dashboard cards now: metric-total-income, metric-total-expenses, metric-net-balance. No metric-cash and no 'Saldo en cuenta' text anywhere on the dashboard (verified).

Sidebar (Layout.jsx): data-testid='sidebar' has data-collapsed='0'/'1' attribute; sidebar-collapse-toggle button toggles it and persists 'sidebar-collapsed' in localStorage (verified value cycles 0->1->0). Mobile sidebar-mobile-toggle slides sidebar in via translate-x, and clicking the overlay (z-40) outside the sidebar (z-50) translates sidebar to -256px (off-screen). Both behaviors verified.

Settings page (/configuracion, data-testid='settings-page') renders all 3 catalog editors: catalog-income_categories, catalog-expense_categories, catalog-payment_methods. Each has -save / -reset / -add / -new-label / -new-value / -row-<value> / -remove-<value> testids. The Save button correctly becomes disabled (dirty=false) after a successful PUT.

Add a new income category 'Marketing-Test' -> auto-slugified to 'marketing_test' -> save -> immediately appears in Transactions '+ Nuevo' Ingreso tx-category dropdown ('Marketing-Test | marketing_test' option visible). Cleanup verified by removing the row and re-saving. Integration with Transactions form is working.

Mobile hamburger (sidebar-mobile-toggle) is visible at width=600px (lg:hidden), clicking opens sidebar (slides to translate-x-0), clicking the overlay area outside the sidebar closes it (sidebar bounding box returns to x=-256). Verified.

Spurious test-script result settings_3_catalogs=FAIL during the combined run was a Playwright is_visible() timing race during catalog list load — the catalog-income_categories element is actually present in DOM and fully functional (we successfully added/saved/removed a row on that same editor right after). Treat as test-script artifact, NOT a bug.
MINOR: PUT /api/settings/catalogs/{key} accepts duplicate labels but the UI enforces uniqueness only on 'value'. That's OK but consider also de-duplicating values server-side to harden the contract.
seed_data_creation: Temporary tx + reimbursement (both cleaned), temporary 'Marketing-Test' income category (cleaned via Settings UI and via PUT-back of original items list). NO production data was left modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 6 selectors verified: metric-net-balance (Saldo Neto), sidebar-collapse-toggle (desktop, persists localStorage 'sidebar-collapsed'), sidebar-mobile-toggle (lg:hidden), sidebar has data-collapsed attr '0'/'1'. Settings page testids: settings-page, catalog-<key> where key in {income_categories,expense_categories,payment_methods}; per-catalog: -save, -reset, -add, -new-label, -new-value, -row-<value>, -remove-<value>. Backend endpoints: GET /api/settings/catalogs, GET /api/settings/catalogs/{key}, PUT /api/settings/catalogs/{key} with body {items:[{value,label}]}. Reimbursement must include source_transaction_ids:[tx_id] to unlock a paid_personally tx for deletion. Expense category enum is 'general|taxes|accountant|travel|materials|labor|services|other' (NOT 'otros').
rca of the issue: N/A — all iteration-6 acceptance criteria are met.
